text:
Marta: Draft attached — landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Quick asks: 1) pick headline variant, 2) confirm webinar messaging and inbound routing. Doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/landing-drafts/4129
Elaine: On it — leaving notes in the doc. My pick: Variant B for Hosted, puts latency promise front-and-center.
Sam: Agree Variant B. For Dedicated, use 'Reserved performance' as the phrasing (less product-jargon-y than 'Dedicated capacity'). Webinar timing? Need to sync with benchmark publish.
Jon: Let's align webinar with the benchmark release — short demo + bench narrative showing latency and $/token comparisons. I can own a 10-min demo walkthrough. For lead form, require: company size, deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private), and primary use case.
Marta: @Jon add a slide titled 'cost vs latency tradeoffs' — a simple heatmap will do. For routing rules: interest=hosted -> Growth team, dedicated -> Sales SDR pool, private -> Enterprise AE.
Sam: Implementation note: add UTM param tri_mode=hosted|dedicated|private and a hidden form field for the same. HubSpot workflow will pivot assignment based on that field. Also add a cookie to persist selection for funnel experiments.
Elaine: Copy tweak for Private page: lead with security controls (KMS/HSM integration, VPC, audit logs). Shorten hero to ~10 words; long intros kill conversion.
Marta: CTA options in the doc: `Start free trial`, `Request a demo`, `Schedule private review`. Thoughts on primary CTA per page?
Jon: Primary for Private: Request a demo. For Hosted: Start free trial. Dedicated can default to Request a demo but show throughput/billing calculator inline.
Marta: Webinar promo plan: 3 short tweets, 2 LinkedIn posts, 1 product-email and 1 partner co-email. Draft social samples in the doc — please :thumbsup: to approve tone.
Sam: Tone looks good. For the benchmark narrative: lead with a customer baseline -> our delta -> what that means (latency, cost). Hold off on publishing raw benchmarks until we have partner sign-off.
Elaine: +1. Measurement plan: GA events for hero CTA clicks, HubSpot lead scoring for webinar registrants, and a short conversion funnel report in the Console dashboard.
dev-rel-bot: Reminder: landing-draft updated at 4129994400 by Marta. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/landing/preview-4129
Marta: Thanks bot. Locking copy pass EOD today. Who wants social scheduling?
Sam: I can handle social scheduling and scheduling the LinkedIn boosts. ETA: EOD Thurs.
Jon: I'll assemble benchmark slides and the demo checklist. ETA: Tue.
Elaine: I'll finalize the Private hero and the webinar email. ETA: Wed.
Marta: Great — locking tasks. One more: add a one-line 'what success looks like' for the webinar (target: 30% webinar->trial conversion for Hosted audience, enterprise engagement for Private).
Sam: Noted — I'll bake that into the promo brief and ad copy.
Marta: Perfect. If nobody objects I’ll ship the locked copy to staging and share the final preview in #marketing by EOD.
